references.text: Here the Sabbath is introduced as a day of rest, which is relevant for understanding Jesus' lordship over the Sabbath.
This verse speaks about honoring the Sabbath, providing insight into the discussion on the significance of the Sabbath in Mark 2:28.
This verse repeats the concept that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath, directly related to Mark 2:28.
Luke gives a parallel account confirming Jesus' authority over the Sabbath, supporting the understanding of Mark 2:28.
